name: Everbloom
description: 开发可洗涤、可生物降解的新型纤维renoa，将羊绒、羊毛和羽绒废料通过AI材料科学模型转化为类羊绒替代纤维，已获美国联邦贸易委员会批准为25年来首个新纤维分类
description_en: Develops washable, biodegradable fiber renoa, converting cashmere, wool, and feather waste into cashmere-like substitute fiber using AI material science models, approved by U.S. FTC as the first new fiber classification in 25 years
why_matters: 利用自研AI材料科学模型突破传统纺织品限制，将废弃蛋白转化为可机洗、不起球、不缩水的高端纤维替代品，解决羊绒环境破坏问题的同时降低成本，预计2027年第二季度首批产品上市
why_matters_en: Uses proprietary AI material science model to overcome traditional textile limitations, transforming waste protein into machine-washable, pill-resistant, shrink-proof premium fiber substitute that addresses cashmere's environmental damage while reducing costs, with first products expected Q2 2027
latest_news: 2026年10月获美国联邦贸易委员会批准renoa为新纤维分类，正与多家公司合作将renoa以20%混纺比例用于羊绒产品，首批商业产品预计2027年第二季度上市
latest_news_en: In October 2026, renoa was approved by U.S. FTC as a new fiber classification; currently working with multiple companies to incorporate renoa at 20% blend ratio in cashmere products, with first commercial products expected Q2 2027
source_title: Here’s what ‘renoa’ — the first new fiber in 25 years — feels like

evidence.quote: Renoa was recently approved as the first new fiber classification in 25 years by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission
The startup developed its own AI model for material science, and a cashmere substitute is the first product

name: Wenti Labs
description: 面向建筑行业的AI操作系统,其AI代理在现有工具内运行,捕获包括照片、消息和报告在内的非结构化数据并即时处理,转换为结构化洞察,已部署于新加坡多个一级总承包商的活跃建筑项目
description_en: AI operating system for construction where AI agents run inside existing tools, capturing unstructured data including photos, messages and reports, instantly processing and converting fragmented inputs into structured insights, deployed on active projects with Tier-1 contractors in Singapore
why_matters: 2023年成立的早期公司,2026年5月完成种子前融资,已与新加坡包括Boustead Projects E&C、Penta-Ocean Construction、Woh Hup等领先行业参与者部署技术,显示建筑行业AI代理的实际应用场景和客户验证
why_matters_en: Founded 2023, raised pre-seed in May 2026, technology already deployed with leading industry players including Boustead Projects E&C, Penta-Ocean Construction, Woh Hup and multiple Tier-1 general contractors in Singapore, demonstrating real-world AI agent adoption in construction
latest_news: 2026年5月完成由Zacua Ventures领投的种子前融资,用于扩大工程团队、加速客户获取,并在新加坡之外的亚太关键市场(包括日本和澳大利亚)增长
latest_news_en: Raised pre-seed round led by Zacua Ventures in May 2026 to expand engineering team, accelerate customer acquisition, and grow presence in key APAC markets beyond Singapore, including Japan and Australia
source_title: 5 Up-and-Coming Proptech Startups from Singapore to Watch - Fintech Singapore

Its AI agents run inside tools teams already use, capturing unstructured data, including photos, messages and reports, instantly processing these data and converting these fragmented inputs into structured insights

name: Playground
description: 谷歌推出的实验性游戏创作平台,用户无需编程知识,仅通过文本提示即可创建、游玩和分享自定义游戏,支持多人游戏和排行榜功能
description_en: Google's experimental gaming platform that allows users to create, play, and share custom games without coding experience, using simple text prompts, with multiplayer and leaderboard support
why_matters: 显著降低了游戏开发门槛,让普通用户通过对话式界面即可实现游戏创意,并计划集成Unity Spark提供专业级3D能力,构建从简单提示到沉浸式体验的完整生态系统
why_matters_en: Significantly lowers barriers to game creation, enabling ordinary users to realize game ideas through conversational interface, with planned Unity Spark integration for professional-grade 3D capabilities, building a complete ecosystem from simple prompts to immersive experiences
latest_news: 2026年10月7日在美国正式上线,面向18岁以上用户开放,根据Google AI订阅级别分层提供创作权限,Unity Spark集成目前正在测试中
latest_news_en: Launched on October 7, 2026 in the U.S. for users 18+, with tiered creation access based on Google AI subscription; Unity Spark integration currently in testing with closed beta coming soon
source_title: Create custom games without coding on Playground

evidence.quote: Today, we're introducing Playground, an experimental gaming platform that lets you create, play, and share custom games.
Playground lowers the barriers to creation, so bringing game ideas to life can now be as easy as describing it through a few prompts — no coding experience required.
